exposure: Maternal obesity (BMI of 30 kg/m2 or above before pregnancy)
cohort: The study included 60 pregnant women with a BMI of 30 kg/m2 or above before pregnancy.
finding: Maternal obesity was associated with higher rates of hypertension (30%), gestational diabetes (25%), caesarean deliveries (41.7%), and neonatal critical care admissions (20%).
mod_finding: 41.7% of overweight mothers experienced caesarean deliveries.
cross-section timing: Data was examined from July 2023 to April 2024.
birth_weight: Average 3,550 grammes for babies born to overweight mothers.
